name: wp-plus-sign-preserved
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] getQueryParams decodes values with decodeURIComponent only, so '+' stays literal. The TS engine uses URLSearchParams, which decodes '+' as space.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruled #10): '+' decodes as space (browser/URL standard; how ad platforms encode spaces). Plugin literal-'+' recorded as accident. Original note: decodeURIComponent vs URLSearchParams.
